body.name: Fixed-dimensional certified empirical MOT procedure
body.construction: Let \(M=\lceil32d/\epsilon\rceil\), let \(h=M^{-1}\), and round every coordinate of every empirical atom to a multiple of the rational mesh \(h\), using a fixed tie rule. Thus the quantization map \(q\) is rational and satisfies \(|q_j(x)-x_j|\le h\) in every coordinate and \(\|q(x)-x\|_2\le dh\). Put the rational allowance \(\eta=3dh\). The procedure \(\mathsf{CertMOT}_\epsilon\) merges coincident quantized atoms, solves the resulting rational dual linear program by the ellipsoid method using exact dynamic-programming separation indexed by partial grid sums, recovers an optimal rational primal witness, lifts that witness through the quantization fibers, and returns the lifted-primal upper certificate and the shifted-dual lower certificate with allowance \(\eta\).
